build_scope: Clean archived main plus VMSTORE changes only; parallel PicoCalc/terminal/display edits excluded.

implementation.prefilter: Find a cache candidate, validate C6 header/canonical literal prefix, compiler identity, language, source ID/size and bytecode version before any source-content read.
implementation.source_crc: One verified full read into the existing 4176-byte compiler-prefix lease when the source fits; otherwise unchanged 256-byte pages. Calculate and compare the source CRC before reserving any image.
implementation.trust: The prefix is a negative filter, not a certificate. Full container CRCs, exact file length, source/compiler key, immutable epoch and ordinary VM verifier remain mandatory after reservation.

measurement.method: Same firmware; identical BASIC.APP and merged Turochamp package in all stages; only VMSTORE varies. Original VMC snapshot restored, then reboot, before each stage. Four searches per stage; USB full-eight-rank board wall clock.
measurement.cold_definition: First search with compilation/RAM fill, not reboot with an already-current chess file cache.

cold.state: Reboot, original VMC snapshot; first compile and RAM fill

resident.whole_ram_gate: PASS: effective free 33696, maximum standalone APP 20480, full stage index 2560, MSC 8264, filesystem temporaries 824

verification.host: ASan/UBSan: math backends 0/1 x USB 0/1 x mixed-cache 0/1 PASS
verification.metadata: Missing/short/corrupt/incompatible compiler/header/key/version/size rejects before source validation; source-CRC mismatch rejects before reserve; full payload CRC/VM verification remain mandatory PASS
verification.boundaries: 4175/4176 => one source-validation read; 4177/65534 => 256-byte paging. Source-size mismatches do not read the source. I/O, short/late reads and epoch changes reject the hit PASS
verification.flows: Existing cold/store, warm/load, old owned formats, collision preservation, corrupt payload, post-reserve length/race, quota/OOM, INPUT/retry/ESC, FOCAL and active-USB canaries PASS

arm.checks: Real VMSTORE ARM: early misses without source reads, bulk/paged CRC, claimed-CRC mismatch, I/O/epoch rejection, full-load CRC, unchanged output on bad payload, preserved values. Storage/allocator are fixtures, not hardware timings.

verification.turochamp_budgets: Both math backends: 24 modules, largest 5609/6144 bytes; source/line/call/value/loop ceilings unchanged PASS
verification.native: Classic Flash, RAM, stack-frame, whole live RAM, CDC receive and retained foreground-stack gates PASS
